commonRuntimeCoverage.setup: Both builds and both API paths receive eight register1 zero writes followed by the actual reset API before each timeline. limits: Raw C ABI and AudioEngine both directly generate at the configured output rate. Clock/divider changes alter nibble consumption; the native fractional phase and FIFO continue across chunk boundaries.
Only supported 4-bit ADPCM is compared. Flags select all divider codes and 10/12-bit output widths. Unsupported 3-bit creation is rejected; no new read/status/IRQ API is introduced.

States are same-build in-process field bytes. Raw bidirectional restore remains within identical constructor clock/flags/output-rate settings; opaque snapshots remain same-owner and require unchanged JS rate/volume/mute settings.
Both layouts save selected checkpoints; continuations replay only the regular layout. State observations occur at chunk boundaries and do not mutate playback.

record.reviewScope: Independent read-only review of final checker, exact input/report hash verification, positive controls and recomputed counters. Reviewer did not edit checker or production code.
reviewedInvariants: Exact73-byte ChipStateIO field layout checked against unchanged header: FIFO occupies offsets49..56, head/tail/count/nibbles57..72; values are in-process little-endian WASM state, not a portable interchange format.

Every actor primes only8inactive FIFO storage bytes through actual writes/reset. Active constructor fields match pre/post; fresh unprimed vs primed playback is explicitly equal. No state masking or production reset modification.
Positive low/high nibble golden vector and separate decoder arithmetic reference; partial-byte restore, FIFO8byte drop-new, wrap ordering and predictor continuity, underrun hold.
Supported flags exercise4divider codes and10/12-bit predictor clipping. Divider512 alias and3distinct speeds positively checked.
Clock bytes8..10 remain pending; register11 commits masked30bit clock; nonzero fractional phase survives clock/divider edits. Main pending-clock checkpoint occurs beforecommit.

Play-while-playing preserves state; stop precedence sets outputzero without consumingqueuednibbles; restart resets predictor/queue, retainsphase. Reset restores active fields while retaining inactive storage.
All pan gates and ignored high bits verified. Engine master gain/mute applies once without changing decoder progression; public opaque states remain owner/settings restricted.
Both chunk layouts compare PCM+allstatebytes; selected continuation replays use regular layout. Raw cross-build restores stay within same constructor clock/flags/rate.
Owned PCM test starts audible, retunes same-buffer contents and forces capacity+1 growth; held output remains unchanged.
Actual public API has no read/status/IRQ; harness does not invent these production endpoints. Full bundle verification covers catalog-omitted chip_state.h.
Main output frames, bounded self-check frames and pre-restore perturbation output frames independently recompute.

notes.handling: Existing reset leaves inactive fifo[8] bytes untouched. Test setup canonicalizes these through8zero writes and reset, verifies active state and PCM unchanged, then compares every serialized byte. This is not a production fix or a claim that reset clears FIFO storage.
